model: RandomForestClassifier (n_estimators=500, random_state=42), zeros in glucose/blood_pressure/skin_thickness/insulin/bmi imputed with train medians
notes: Excluded followup_score because it is almost perfectly separated by outcome (likely measured after diagnosis); including it gives ~0.93 test accuracy, which is leakage. Stratified 80/20 split, random_state=42.
